description: Demolition of existing buildings (excluding the Toll House) and erection of 343 residential units including 30 affordable housing units (19x4 bed houses, 1x3 bed house 16x3 bed flats, 218x2 bed flatsand 89x1 bed flats), 14 live/work/atelier units, a 140 bed hotel,various retail and A3 (restaurant/cafe/public house) units, surface and underground parking, a public square off the High Steet, creation of island park, use of former Toll House as heritage/office centre, wetland ecological area, two bridges to the small island, harbour masters office, chandlery and boaters facilities,moorings, towpath and highway improvements, and felling of trees T2-T8in London Borough of Hounslow TPO No.347.
